dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "34: Those who release junk while airborne will be subject to lifetime imprisonment."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "For the safety of everyone, nobody is allowed to release any airborne objects around the trial grounds without obtaining prior approval. This includes kites, balloons, and birds!"

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "In a previous case, someone released a balloon and it impacted a Qucusaurus' flight path. If it weren't for a flying squad member administering timely assistance, the results would have been disastrous!"

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "The chief has also stated that safety is paramount. This kind of thing cannot happen again. So follow the rules, everyone!"
